src='''from collections import deque

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and not seen[i][j]:
                comp=[]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for x,y in ((a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)):
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y] and not seen[x][y]:
                            seen[x][y]=True; q.append((x,y))
                rs=[c[0] for c in comp]; cs=[c[1] for c in comp]
                r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
                colors=sorted({g[a][b] for a,b in comp}, key=lambda v: min(min(a-r0,r1-a,b-c0,c1-b) for a,b in comp if g[a][b]==v))
                remap={v: colors[len(colors)-1-k] for k,v in enumerate(colors)}
                for a,b in comp: out[a][b]=remap[g[a][b]]
    return out
'''
